capabilities.title: Compress personal data into scored local memory trees backed by durable storage
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md The brain and Context in minutes sections
capabilities.reason: Nexus has durable memory records and compiled pages but not a scored hierarchical memory tree with explicit compression and lineage.

capabilities.title: Mirror durable memory into an operator-editable Markdown wiki
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md Memory Tree plus Obsidian Wiki description
capabilities.reason: VAULT exposes compiled memory pages, but an editable bidirectional Markdown wiki with conflict handling is not yet present.

capabilities.title: Give the AI immediate operator-controlled context about goals, work, learning, skills, and constraints
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md SuperContext and Context in minutes sections

capabilities.title: Maintain long-term goals and durable task state
Connect external services and tool servers through governed integrations
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md OAuth integrations, MCP servers, and Skills

capabilities.title: Continuously ingest connected accounts into personal memory on a background schedule
capabilities.reason: Silent account-wide ingestion conflicts with Nexus connector opt-in, data minimization, and operator-controlled memory boundaries.

capabilities.title: Continuously diff personal data, advance goals, and write briefings after the operator stops typing
capabilities.reason: An opaque always-on loop that modifies goals or memory would bypass Nexus review gates and explicit scheduling controls.

capabilities.title: Compress tool output before model ingestion while preserving useful information
capabilities.reason: Nexus bounds context and tool output, but a measured semantic compression stage with quality acceptance is not yet proven.

capabilities.title: Let the AI propose workflows that the operator reviews before saving or executing
Persist graph runs so they pause for humans, survive restarts, resume, and expose root causes
capabilities.reason: The Nexus runtime records artifacts and bounded handoffs but does not yet resume an interrupted multi-agent graph from a durable checkpoint.

capabilities.title: Route simple inbound work quickly and delegate complex work to deeper reasoning
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md A split brain, always on

capabilities.title: Use a central orchestrator to delegate bounded specialist missions and consolidate results
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md An orchestrator, not a chatbot

capabilities.title: Coordinate external agents through encrypted identities, bounties, payments, and trading
capabilities.reason: Payments and trading conflict with the Nexus free/no-billing product invariant and add unnecessary financial and identity risk.

capabilities.title: Select relevant local memory, files, and live context before the model receives a request
Provide research, web, browser, and coding tools behind one agent runtime
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md The deep researcher and doer

capabilities.title: Select models per workload and support a local-only inference posture
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md Model routing and Privacy Mode

capabilities.title: Join video meetings, transcribe live speech, answer by name, and file action items
capabilities.reason: Nexus has voice tooling but no consent-aware meeting attendance, calendar join, participant disclosure, or transcript retention workflow.

capabilities.title: Reach the operator through many messaging channels and native email
capabilities.reason: Nexus has bounded channel integrations but not a unified consent, identity, delivery, and retention layer for the claimed channel breadth.

capabilities.title: Generate and edit images and videos directly into the workspace
capabilities.reason: Nexus has governed asset-generation workflows, but a unified in-app image and video generation surface is not proven as part of the AI runtime.

capabilities.title: Provide a local desktop UI instead of requiring terminal-only operation
Encrypt local personal data and keep secrets in the operating-system keyring
capabilities.reason: Nexus protects secrets and local access, but comprehensive at-rest encryption plus OS-keyring proof for every personal-memory record is not yet documented.

capabilities.title: Enforce a runtime mode in which inference and protected data do not leave the machine
Present a speaking, reacting mascot that remembers the operator as a human-like companion
capabilities.reason: Nexus agents may have clear working styles, but simulated emotion or relationship framing would misrepresent the system and distract from the intelligence-dashboard purpose.

capabilities.title: Edit visual themes and export them as reusable JSON
capabilities.reason: Nexus supports theme preferences but does not expose a full token editor with validated JSON import and export.

capabilities.title: Replay agent runs and inspect per-call cost accounting
capabilities.reason: Nexus captures run artifacts and evaluation history, but deterministic replay and complete per-call cost journals are not yet proven.

capabilities.title: Reuse the OpenHuman Rust and TypeScript implementation directly
capabilities.reason: Nexus adapts capability patterns without copying GPL-3.0 implementation code into its MIT runtime.
